status: The layout spec for the sitting on the LVGL face: every drawn region names its word or composition, the states pose, place, confirm and begin, the focus as data, the events, the bottom line and the strings
note: The one home of the sitting's numbers, transcribed from station-layouts.md (Sitting) and its wireframes 14-sitting-pose.svg to 14d-sitting-nav.svg. Rectangles are [x, y, w, h] in screen pixels; `at` offsets are from the region's own origin. The sitting spends a held sitting on one mibi: the player picks a pose from its habits and a place it has been, looks, and confirms. Its left half is Habitat's living window, unchanged, so the mibi stays where it stood; the choices are at the right, the three steps along the foot.

notes.where: its own screen under Habitat (frame.json navigation.screens.sitting: parent habitat, back Habitat), opened from Habitat's Portrait module with ✓ Portray {name}, only while a sitting is held and the mibi can sit (sitting.portraitBlock empty: it has a habit seen and a place been)
notes.rules: prototypes/station/src/sitting.mjs: offer(st, m) gives the poses (the habits seen, habitsOf) and the places (where it has been, placesOf); beginSitting(st, m, pose, place) spends the held sitting and nothing else, sends the crate to the bay and sets the mibi's portrait painting. Nothing is spent before the last ✓
notes.window: the same bezel, glass, mibi box and name tag as Habitat, so the screen change keeps the mibi where it stood; the glass shows a plain backdrop, washed in the focused place's colours on the place step
notes.frame: the gilt frame around the window from the look-and-confirm step: the portrait to be. It lights when the confirm is armed
notes.amber: nothing on the sitting is amber

rules.closedList: station-layouts.md, The derived rules (closed): railCompaction slantTabs pageGrid platePosition listPitch splicePlan guideColumns pipGroups leafArc
rules.listPitch: the cards (three columns, two rows), the chosen cards and the three step tiles are lists by pitch: { first, pitch, grid }

stateRule: pose: pick one of the mibi's habits seen. place: pick one of the places it has been. confirm: look at the choice in the gilt frame and confirm, arm-then-confirm. begin: from the second ✓ until the screen changes to Habitat (events.begin), input held. ✓ on a card goes a step forward; ← goes a step back (from pose, to Habitat). A region with `inStates` exists only in those states

glass.note: a plain stage in the vivarium's light; no words but the name tag

resident.asset: the mibi's standard painting (the portrait is not shown before it is painted)

nameTag.note: as on Habitat; not a target here

gilt.note: the gilt frame drawn over the bezel, its opening the glass; lit while the confirm is armed

card.chosen: the card chosen before (on coming back a step): fill `hairline`, one step up

cards.order: pose: the habits seen, in the order the species frame lists them; place: the places been, the pod's place first, then in the order walked to

chosen.note: the pose's card, then the place's card, as chosen; not targets

thumb.pictures: the chosen card's picture rendered at 48: pose-{species}-{habit}-48x48, place-{place}-48x48 (existing)

states.done: fill `panel`, the word `bone`, the chosen picture

backdrop.do: the place step: the ring moved to another place card; the backdrop cross-dithers to that place's (lvgl-switch.md §2.7). Entering the place step dithers from the plain backdrop to the first place's; going back to the pose step dithers to the plain one

step.do: ✓ on a card or ← inside: the heading, the cards, the steps' tiles and the bottom line change on the frame of the key (cuts); the gilt frame shows on the confirm step (a cut)

steps.do: the lit gilt frame dithers out (16 levels): the frame leaves for the bay
the screen transition (16-level Bayer dither) to Habitat, the ring on the Portrait module, its frame in the painting state; the message plate strings.beganPlate

begin.then: Home's sitting slot shows empty; the crate waits at the bay until it is ready (sitting.mjs crateState)

pose.initial: the card chosen before, else card.0

card.id: card.<i>, i from 0 in the cards' order

confirm.armed: room: after the first ✓; the gilt frame lights; any key but ✓ clears the arm
confirm.room: the ring on nothing: the gilt frame is the focus; ✓ arms, then begins

focus.held: while events.begin holds, the face moves no focus and sends no intent

keys.pad: pose and place: moves the ring among the cards; confirm: nothing
keys.confirm: pose: this pose, then the place step; place: this place, then the confirm step; confirm: the first ✓ arms (the gilt frame lights), the second begins the sitting (events.begin)
keys.back: a step back, keeping the choice made there (the ring on it): confirm to place, place to pose; from pose, Habitat with the ring on the Portrait module. Nothing is spent
keys.room: as everywhere (frame.json navigation.roomKeys); the choices are dropped and nothing is spent, as on Create and Cross

masters.note: every master the sitting names, at the size it is shown; none is drawn by the build
list: sitting-backdrop-{place}-544x408, one a place (meadow, pond, rock, wood, cave)
pose-{species}-{habit}-96x96 and -48x48, one a habit of each species frame

strings.title: Sitting
strings.habits: the habit as an -ing phrase: "shaking dry", "calm", "sleeping curled", "sniffing", "puffing", "digging", "glowing"
strings.places: the place's word: "the meadow", "the pond edge", "the rock field", "the wood", "the cave"
strings.note: the frame's zones (station-layouts.md, The frame): a verb phrase of four words or fewer for the action, a label of six words or fewer for the context; no dot-joined parts; "Again: …" is the arm's wording

buildChanges: the build has no sitting screen: sitting.mjs holds its rules headless (offer, beginBlock, beginSitting); habitat.mjs offers no Portray
Habitat's Portrait module (habitat.json regions.portrait) opens this screen with ✓ Portray {name}; begin returns to Habitat with the ring on it
